1. Present petition has been filed by the petitioner, under Section 528 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha
Sanhita, 2023, seeking quashing of Fir No. 0157 dated 25.05.2022 (P-1) under Section 120-B, 406,
420, 467,468,471 of Indian Penal Code, 1860, registered at Police Station Civil Line, Bhiwani,
District Bhiwani and all the consequential proceedings arising out from the abovesaid Fir.

2.  On the very outset, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that Coordinate Bench has already passed the order dated 30.07.2025 in CRM-M- 40402-2025 titled as 'Vinod Kumar Kakkar Vs. State of Haryana' whereby petition filed by co-accused namely Vinod Kumar Kakkar has been dismissed as withdrawn by exempting his personal appearance subject to certain conditions.

sentences.text: Mr. Jamshed Ahmed, Advocate has put in appearance on behalf of the petitioner and filed his power of attorney with an endorsement of no objection from earlier counsel.
The same is taken on record.
Registry is directed to tag the same at the appropriate place.
3. Learned State counsel, at the very outset, submits that the first petition seeking quashing of FIR (supra)on merits was withdrawn on 04.03.2024 in case bearing CRM-M No.46857 of 2023.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioner wishes to withdraw the present petition and seeks liberty to raise all the pleas taken in the present petition, at the appropriate stage, during the course of trial and confines his prayer to the extent that petitioner is a senior citizen, aged about 72 years and is suffering from various old-age ailments.

As such, attending the trial on each and every date would cause great inconvenience and hardship to him.
5.
The instant petition is dismissed as withdrawn with the liberty as prayed for.

* * * *

Sanjay Vashisth, J.(Oral)
1. Present petition has been filed by the petitioner, under Section 528 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha
Sanhita, 2023, seeking quashing of Fir No. 0157 dated 25.05.2022 (P-1) under Section 120-B, 406,
420, 467,468,471 of Indian Penal Code, 1860, registered at Police Station Civil Line, Bhiwani,
District Bhiwani and all the consequential proceedings arising out from the abovesaid Fir.
However, in view of the ratio laid down by this Court in CRM-M-25963-2023 titled as 'Suresh Kumar and another Vs. The State of Haryana and another' 2023 (2) Law Herald 1498, the personal appearance of the petitioner before the learned trial Court is ordered to be exempted, subject to the following conditions:-
i) petitioner shall be represented through his counsel;
ii) shall not delay/stall the trial proceedings;
iii) shall not dispute his identity as accused;
iv) shall have no objection if the prosecution evidence is recorded in his absence but in the presence of his counsel;
2 of 3 CRM-M-37693-2025 (O&M) -3- v) shall appear before the trial Court as and when required; and vi) any other condition, which the trial Court may impose."
